1. storeScan.js: add an exported `listIssueResourceIds({shopId, tab, issueTypes, cursor = null, limit})` reusing checklistDocsQuery with a `terms` on 'checklistIssues.keyword', same sort/search_after as listStoreIssuePages, returning {gids, nextCursor, hasNext}; build each gid from the doc (look at what fields the ES docs carry — resourceId + resourceType/tab → `gid://shopify/Product/<id>` etc.; Article gids too). Add a helper mapping (section 'meta-title'|'meta-desc', kind from META_ISSUE_KIND or undefined) → issue types: missing→[metaTitle] / [metaDescription], length→[metaTitleLength] / [metaDescriptionLength], undefined→both. Export it (generateBulkService and the controller both need it; put it where it avoids an import cycle — storeScan already imports from generateBulkService? check and avoid a cycle).
2. analysisController getList metaIssue branch: replace scanForIssueNodes + predicate with listIssueResourceIds (cursor = ctx.query.after, limit = min(first||10, 50)); fetch nodes with analysisService._fetchNodes (or whatever non-swallowing fetch exists — errors must reach the existing catch, not become an empty page); keep pageInfo shape {hasNext, hasPre:false, endCursor}. Shop not synced (needsChecklistSync on the JobDataMigrateRepository doc, same pattern as storeScan.refreshChecklistDocs ~L516) → return data [] with pageInfo no-next and `needsSync: true`. Drop the now-unused imports.
3. Bulk ISSUES (subscribeGenFaq isAuto path, option === RESOURCE_GEN_OPTION.ISSUES only): page through listIssueResourceIds (cursor is the ES search_after id string instead of a GraphQL cursor — make sure the chain's cursor handling accepts it for this option) and load the batch with the existing fetchResourcesByIds({shopify, ids}); no matchesGenOption re-judging for ISSUES. Unsynced shop → zero resources, run completes normally, zero credits. ALL and WITHOUT options unchanged. Keep matchesGenOption's ISSUES branch only if something else still needs it; otherwise remove hasMetaIssue/loadAppMetaContext usages that become dead (grep packages/functions and packages/assets).
4. issueCount for meta sections in getResourceReport: read it from the index (sum of failed counts for the section's issue types across product/collection/article — readStoreResources in storeScan.js already returns per-tab `failed` counts) instead of countResourcesWithFaq's withMetaIssue; unsynced → 0. Remove withMetaIssue from countResourcesWithFaq if it becomes unused.
Tests (mock ES service + repositories with factories): storeScan listIssueResourceIds (query has shop scope + terms + search_after, gid building, hasNext); analysisController metaIssue branch (ids from ES → nodes; unsynced → needsSync; node fetch error → error response not empty data) — extend or mirror existing controllers/__tests__/analysisController.*.test.js mocking style; subscribeGenFaq ISSUES (only ES ids generated/charged; unsynced → no generation, no credit) — mirror handlers/pubsub/__tests__/subscribeGenFaq.pricing.test.js; generateBulkService tests still green. Three bugs in the checklist scan's writes:
(A) packages/functions/src/services/audit/runner.js ~L69-73: `kept` comes from shop.issueFixed read at scan START (~L21) and is written with updateShop(shop.id, {issueFixed: kept}, true) after a multi-minute scan — a merge-set that replaces the whole array, so an 'I have fixed already' click made during the scan is lost. Fix: remove only the reopened entries atomically (FieldValue.arrayRemove(...reopened) on the shop doc — check how shopRepository/updateShop writes and whether issueFixed entries are plain strings so arrayRemove matches). Keep using `kept` for this scan's in-memory result.
(B) services/audit/applyImageAltResult.js writes the finished missing-alt count into the stored checklist unless there is no lastScanAt; it ignores `checklist.scanning`. A scan in progress then overwrites it with the stale/pending emptyImageAlt computed earlier from imageAltReport (runner.js ~L78-87 final pushChecklist). Fix: applyImageAltResult returns early while checklist.scanning is true; in the runner, right before the final pushChecklist, re-read the optimize report (the same getter services/audit/artifacts/imageAltReport.js uses) and, when it now has a finished count, replace the emptyImageAlt issue result with EmptyImageAlt.fromCounts(...) (as applyImageAltResult does) before prepareIssue/score. A first-ever scan (no lastScanAt yet) also benefits from this re-read.
(C) handlers/webhook/bulkOperationHook.js hookCountResourceMissingAlt (~L493-505): when bulkOp has no `url` it writes DONE with missingAltCount 0 / syncTotalImagesCount 0 — correct for a COMPLETED op with zero results, wrong for a FAILED/CANCELED/EXPIRED op, which then reports '0 missing alt' as a pass for 24h. Fix: inspect the bulk op status field the webhook payload/handler already has (read handleHook ~L280-300 to see what bulkOp contains); non-COMPLETED → write syncTotalImagesStatus FAILED and leave counts untouched; COMPLETED with no url → current behaviour.
Tests: services/audit/__tests__/runnerIssueFixed.test.js (arrayRemove used, no whole-array overwrite), services/audit/__tests__/applyImageAltResult.scanning.test.js, services/audit/__tests__/runnerAltReread.test.js (final push uses fresh count), handlers/webhook/__tests__/bulkOperationHook.missingAlt.test.js (FAILED op → FAILED status, counts untouched; COMPLETED no url → zero counts). Mock like services/audit/__tests__/runAudits.test.js.
